name: CroasterControl
description: Heater and fan control add-on for Croaster. src/core: pure logic (PID, relay autotune, roast profile, MAX31855/MAX6675 decode, command protocol, safety rules), host-tested. src/hw: ESP32 drivers (thermocouple SPI reader, SSR heater, AC dimmer or PWM fan). src/app: the FreeRTOS control task, NVS settings, ControlPlugin for CroasterApp, and the probe bridges into CroasterCore.
